basis: The live pricing-feed rows anchored on https://kie.ai/kling-4-0-flash?model=kling-4.0%2Fflash-reference-to-video and the live GET /api/v1/models pricingDesc agree: at 720p, the only resolution, 17 credits (0.085 USD) per output second without video input, and 11.3 credits (0.0565 USD) per billed second with video input (reference videos or video elements), where the billed seconds are output x 2 while the summed input is no longer than the output and input + output past that (the pricingDesc's worked example: 10 s output + 5 s input = 20 s; with a 15 s input, 25 s). entry.title: Kling 4.0 Flash Reference to Video
entry.pricingDesc:
720P: 11.3 credits/s ($0.0565/s, with video) | 17 credits/s ($0.085/s, no video)

🔸Note🔸: Video input has a lower per-second rate because the input duration is billed as well.

- No video input (text, images or image elements only): rate × output duration
- With video input (reference videos or video elements): rate × (output × 2) when total input duration ≤ output duration; rate × (input + output) when input is longer. Multiple input videos are summed. Example: 10 s output + 5 s input = 20 s; with a 15 s input, 25 s.

High-tier top-ups include +10% bonus credits. Effective pricing is approximately 10% lower than the above rates.

callbackExamples.note: not a Flash bill: 425 credits for 10 s is the non-Flash 1080p no-video rate (42.5 credits/s), and the example reuses the non-Flash Kling 4.0 page's task ids
